items.title: Dreame and Eufy are offering nearly 60 percent off robovacs for Black Friday
items.raw:
Between putting up decorations, entertaining guests, and meal prep, the holidays are busy enough without worrying about vacuuming. Thankfully, a proper robot vacuum can do the dirty work while you focus on more enjoyable things. And thanks to Black Friday, you can pick up some of the best we’ve tested for up to 60 percent off.
We’re seeing some excellent deals on a wide range of robot vacuums, including some of our favorite models from Roborock, Dreame, and Eufy. There are also rare discounts already available on premium models like the Matic and Matic Serene, which impressed us with their almost humanlike navigation, while midrange options such as the Eufy Omni C28 have dropped into budget territory. Whether you want a high-end model that cleans itself or something budget-friendly but still powerful, we’ve rounded up the best deals we’ve found so far.
Roborock Q10 S5 Plus
Despite lacking a multifunction dock, the budget-friendly robot vacuum and mop offers an impressive set of features for the price, including AI-powered obstacle avoidance, sonic mopping, automatic mop lifting, and a self-emptying dock.

Where to Buy:

 $549.99 $229.99 at Amazon
 $549.99 $229.99 at Roborock

Roborock Qrevo Curv 2 Flow
Roborock’s first roller-mop robot vacuum, the Curv 2 Flow, features flagship specs at a midrange price, including excellent mopping, a retractable mop cover, 20,000Pa suction, AI-powered obstacle avoidance, and a compact design.

Where to Buy:

 $999.99 $549.99 at Amazon 

Matic robot vacuum
The Matic robot vacuum and mop is ideal for cluttered homes with pets, multiple floors, and a mixture of carpets and hardwood. It offers almost humanlike navigation, tackling high-pile rugs and mopping up wet spills. The quiet bot also requires less maintenance than many rivals thanks to its onboard water tank and dust bag. Read our review.


Where to Buy:

 $1795 $1495 at Matic (Standard Bundle)
 $1995 $1595 at Matic (Serene Bundle)

Eufy Omni C28
The Eufy Omni C28 combines excellent mopping performance with a small self-cleaning dock that’s well suited for apartments and other smaller spaces. It navigates around furniture and into tight areas with ease, while its roller mop does a great job cleaning hard floors.

Where to Buy:

 $799.99 $360.99 at Walmart (with on-page coupon)

Dreame X60 Ultra
The Dreame X60 Ultra is a powerful robot vacuum and mop that does a great job of cleaning carpets thanks to its dual roller brushes and 35,000Pa of suction. It can climb over tall thresholds, squeeze under low furniture, and automatically detach its mop pads when vacuuming carpets.

Where to Buy:

 $1499.99 $999.99 at Amazon
 $1499.99 $999.99 at Best Buy (with Dreame W10 vacuum)
 $1499.99 $999.99 at Dreame

Narwal Flow 2
If you have all hardwood floors, the Narwal Flow 2 is an excellent option. A superb mop with a wide flat roller pad and an excellent vacuum, the Flow 2 also has top-notch navigation and obstacle detection. Its sleek base station is also less of an eyesore than most.

Where to Buy:

 $1499.99 $949.99 at Amazon (with on-page coupon)
 $1499.99 $949.99 at Narwal
 $1499.99 $949.99 at Wayfair

Roborock Saros 20
Roborock’s Saros 20 stands out for its ability to climb tall thresholds, avoid obstacles with impressive accuracy, and clean under low furniture thanks to its slim design. It also combines powerful 36,000Pa suction with great spinning mop pads, which is why we recommend it for homes with multiple floor types and tricky transitions between rooms.

Where to Buy:

 $1599.99 $989.99 at Amazon
 $1599.99 $989.99 at Walmart
 $1599.99 $989.99 at Roborock

Ecovacs Deebot X12 OmniCyclone
Ecovacs’ robot vacuum and mop can pretreat stains, keep carpets dry with a smart mop cover, and deliver powerful 22,000Pa suction. It also includes an all-in-one dock that automatically empties the dustbin, refills the water tanks, and washes the mop with heated, pressurized water.

Where to Buy:

 $1499.99 $749 at Amazon

Switchbot K11 Plus
The Matter-compatible SwitchBot  K11 Plus is ideal for small apartments, bedrooms, and home offices. It can easily navigate around chair and desk legs and into tight spaces that most other bots miss. It also features a commendable 6,000Pa of suction power — which is great for this price point — and works well on both hardwood and carpet.

Where to Buy:

 $399.99 $169.56 at Amazon (with on-page coupon)
 $399.99 $160 at SwitchBot (with code BFCMX60)

Dreame X50 Ultra
With high suction power, an improved brush system, and the ability to scale thresholds up to 6cm, the X50 Ultra stands out as a great robot vacuum-mop hybrid. While its 20,000Pa suction isn’t quite as powerful as the X60 Ultra’s and it can’t tackle especially high thresholds as well, it’s still an excellent option. Its edge cleaning also isn’t quite as effective as the X60 Ultra’s, but you’re otherwise getting many of the same features for a lot less.

Where to Buy:

 $1599.99 $799.99 at Amazon
 $1599.99 $799.99 at Dreame 
 $1599.99 $799.99 at Target

Dreame L40 Ultra Gen 2
The Dreame L40 Ultra Gen 2 delivers powerful 25,000Pa suction, AI-powered obstacle avoidance, and a self-cleaning dock that empties the dustbin, washes the mop, and refills its water tanks. Unlike the X50 Ultra, however, it lacks the ability to climb high thresholds or stairs.

Where to Buy:

 $799.99 $474.98 at Amazon
 $799.99 $474.98 at Dreame

items.title: You can lock in Hulu and Disney Plus for as low as $5 per month for a year
items.raw:
Emmy Rossum leads the fantastic cast of Furious. | Image: Hulu	

The Black Friday offers on streaming services are rolling in, and the latest deal includes Disney Plus and Hulu for a steeply discounted monthly rate. There are sales happening for both the ad-supported and ad-free tiers that offer full access to both services, and either will save you quite a bit of money. 
For those who despise ads, you can opt for the ad-free version for $14.99 per month (was $21.99) for a year, costing you $180 instead of $264 over the duration. This deal is located in a small banner near the bottom of the sale page via Hulu or Disney Plus. The ad-supported tier drops from $12.99 to just $4.99, so you’ll pay $60 over the course of the year instead of $156. You have through Cyber Monday, November 30th, at 11:59PM PST to take advantage of the lower prices.
Disney Plus, Hulu Bundle

Where to Buy:

 $12.99 $4.99 at Hulu (ad-supported, monthly)
 $21.99 $14.99 at Hulu (ad-free, monthly)

The Hulu and Disney Plus bundle is one of the best values in streaming, especially if you have kids who can’t get enough Disney movies and other cartoons. On the other hand, Hulu is home to plenty of shows made for adults, including Furious (a crime drama that gripped this household like no other show this year), The Bear, Shōgun, Alien: Earth, The Lowdown, and many more. It’s worth the subscription just for those alone. 
The bundle includes Star Wars and Marvel content plus fun, uplifting shows to dig into over the holidays, like Bob’s Burgers, Futurama, The Simpsons, and It’s Always Sunny in Philadelphia, to name some mainstays that tend to attract subscribers.
If you’re considering other subscription services, we covered discounts on Paramount Plus (I might snag this to watch Cupertino), HBO Max, and Peacock. (The Fall and Rise of Reggie Dinkins is fun!)

items.title: Harman Kardon’s classic, see-through SoundSticks 4 are half off
items.raw:
Harman Kardon’s alien-looking SoundSticks became synonymous with the Mac in the early 2000s, and they sounded pretty great. But did you know the company still makes them? After selling steadily for $300 for several years and then spiking to $330 in recent months, the last-gen version of the iconic transparent speaker system is available for an all-time low of $149.99 from Harman Kardon, or $199.95 on Amazon. The discount puts them within range of most other desktop speakers you might consider sticking, or displaying, in your lounge area.
Harman Kardon SoundSticks 4 audio system

Where to Buy:

 $300 $199.99 at Amazon 
 $300 $199.99 at Best Buy
 $300 $149.99 at Harman Kardon

In addition to 3.5mm aux connectivity, the SoundSticks 4 support Bluetooth audio. The 2.1-channel system features two wired satellite speakers, each containing four drivers, and a powerful subwoofer encapsulated in a see-through dome. You can adjust the system’s volume by tapping the touch-sensitive plus or minus sections flanking the logo on the subwoofer. That’s not ideal if your plan was to hide the sub from sight, but I’d argue that most people interested in this model likely plan to showcase it on a shelf instead of tuck it away.
The newer SoundSticks 5 are available on sale for $279.95 (originally $349.95), and beyond a couple of minor design updates, the system features LED lighting and an HDMI ARC port for those who want to use it as their home entertainment system.

items.title: California’s coastal communities on alert as biggest waves in years hit state
items.raw:
Hazard warnings issued throughout week after powerful swells and waves of more than 9 metres recorded
Multiple coastal hazard warnings were issued this week across California as successive areas of low pressure generated powerful swells and large breaking waves for coastal communities. Beaches and piers were closed last weekend as large waves crashed into California’s coastline. Offshore National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration buoys recorded wave heights of greater than 30ft (9 metres) last Friday. The Monterey, California, buoy recorded a wave height of 34.1ft, which would make it the highest reading in 30 years.
Coastal warnings extended from last weekend through this week, with alerts extending until Friday night. Waves of 10-18ft are expected, with local sets of 18-22ft for San Luis Obispo county beaches and Santa Barbara county central coast beaches. These Pacific storm systems are also bringing unsettled conditions across the western US, with heavy rain, mountain snow, and strong winds through the coming days. Already, record-breaking rainfall affected San Fransisco on Wednesday, with heavy rain also causing 32,000 customers to lose power in Sacramento. Into this weekend, a further area of low pressure will bring considerable amounts of moisture for southern Oregon and northern California. By Sunday night, more than 100mm (4in) of rain is expected in places, with further snowfall for areas such as Donner Pass across the northern Sierra Nevada mountains.
